Markets.title: US stocks today: Nasdaq slumps 2.5%, S&P 1% as revived AI doubts ignite tech selloff
Markets.summary: US stocks dropped sharply as renewed concerns over heavy artificial intelligence spending triggered a major selloff in technology and semiconductor shares. Meanwhile, oil prices climbed to a five-month high due to fresh tensions in the Middle East.

Markets.title: Moderna stock crashes 25%, loses about $24 billion after cancer vaccine data leak
Markets.summary: Moderna's stock price plummeted over 25%, erasing about $24 billion in market value following the disclosure of trial results for its personalized melanoma vaccine with Merck. Despite the steep decline, the trial results demonstrated promising reductions in melanoma.

Markets.title: Treasuries see best day in over a year as AI selloff revives haven demand
Markets.summary: US Treasury bonds experienced their largest price surge in over a year as a major selloff in AI-related stocks drove demand for safe-haven assets. Consequently, investors reduced their expectations for a December Federal Reserve rate hike due to growing concerns regarding artificial intelligence spending and domestic economic growth.

Markets.title: Neocloud short sellers rack up $6 billion as AI debt fears deepen
Markets.summary: Short sellers betting against US neocloud and data centre companies have earned about $6 billion in paper profits this month. This selloff was driven by growing investor concerns over debt-fuelled AI infrastructure spending among firms like CoreWeave, Nebius, and IREN.

Markets.title: Pershing's Ackman sees a $1 trillion Israeli company within a decade
Markets.summary: Billionaire investor Bill Ackman predicts Israel will produce a $1 trillion company within the next decade. He attributes this optimistic outlook to the nation's strong technology ecosystem, artificial intelligence potential, and small population.

Markets.title: Average long-term US mortgage rate eases to 7.32% in first pullback since late August
Markets.summary: The average 30-year US mortgage rate dropped to 7.32% from 7.41% last week, marking the first decline since late August. Although this provides slight relief for homebuyers, elevated borrowing costs continue to suppress US home sales and demand.

Geo-Political.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Newborn twins Raghad and Raad are fighting for survival amidst Yemen's hunger crisis. Their family was forced to flee their home on foot due to fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

Geo-Political.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
Geo-Political.summary: Websites were taken offline after developers discovered critical security vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language. Organizations are now racing to update their computer systems to address these flaws.

Geo-Political.title: Trump ordered to answer questions under oath in BBC lawsuit
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump has been ordered to answer questions under oath in his lawsuit against the BBC. The legal action stems from a Panorama episode that deceptively edited two different parts of his 2021 speech.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says Musk has restored access to Ukraine's Starlink network
Geo-Political.summary: Donald Trump stated that Elon Musk has restored Ukraine's access to the Starlink satellite network for military use. Musk has previously denied restricting Ukraine's access to the system.

Geo-Political.title: Crowd of 50 beats foreigner to death in South Africa
Geo-Political.summary: A crowd of 50 people beat an unidentified foreigner to death in South Africa. This attack follows a wave of anti-migrant protests in the country this year.

Geo-Political.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
Geo-Political.summary: Germany faces intensive espionage after authorities arrested a Ukrainian man suspected of spying for Russia. This incident is one of several similar espionage cases reported in Germany this year.

Data & Insights.title: India's Mideast oil imports return to pre-war levels in September
Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. This recovery was driven by refiners purchasing spot cargoes as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz increased.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers switched parties by exploiting loopholes in the country's anti-defection law. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers hold differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: Two members of the RBI Monetary Policy Committee opposed shifting the policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening during the October meeting. However, all six members supported raising the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.

Data & Insights.title: Core sector growth accelerates to 7.9% in September, fastest in new series
Data & Insights.summary: India's core sector growth accelerated to 7.9% in September, driven by double-digit increases in iron ore, electricity, coal, refinery products, and cement. However, fertilizers, natural gas, and crude oil experienced contractions ranging from 1.4% to 11.7%.

Data & Insights.title: India's infrastructure output grows 7.9% year-on-year in September on strong coal, steel output
Data & Insights.summary: India's infrastructure output grew by 7.9% year-on-year in September, accelerating from 3.1% growth in the same month last year. This expansion was driven by strong production increases in coal, refinery products, steel, and iron ore.

India.title: Punjab Hit As Over 3 Lakh Government Employees, Roadways Workers On Strike
India.summary: Over 300,000 government and roadways workers in Punjab launched a strike after negotiations failed. The ongoing protest by contract transport unions has severely disrupted bus services throughout the state.

India.title: Gurugram Plunges Into Darkness As Electricity Workers Go On Strike
India.summary: Gurugram experienced power outages because electricity workers went on strike. The employees are protesting the government's plan to privatize the power distribution system in Gurugram and Nuh.

India.title: Angry Over Sister's Affair, Gujarat Man Poisons Teen, Stages It As Suicide
India.summary: A Gujarat man angered by his sister's affair lured 19-year-old Ashok Bhagabhai Thakor to a farm shed and murdered him. The perpetrator poisoned the victim with spiked liquor and strangled him, staging the homicide as a suicide.

India.title: BJP Worker Killed In Bengal's Malda, 1 Arrested. Family Blames Trinamool
India.summary: A 27-year-old BJP worker named Sameer Ghosh was killed in West Bengal's Malda district, leading to one arrest. The victim's family has accused the opposition Trinamool Congress of carrying out the murder.
